headline: Elevated Tail into the U.S. cash-open checkpoint
body: Nasdaq futures were reported about 1.1% higher after a prior verified NQ sequence of repeated extension and near-high retention. Fresh supplementary context showed broad megacap and semiconductor strength, while lower oil and Treasury yields reinforced the equity bid. Tail remains elevated rather than high because current granular pullback evidence is incomplete.

outlookSummary: Current Tail is 29% / elevated. Conditional Tail peaks at 36% around the cash open only if the opening auction extends the premarket move and early retracements remain shallow or fail; two-way price discovery would de-escalate the path.
